parsed.narrative_sentence: Led regulated-insurance cloud modernization by pairing migration execution with shared-responsibility guardrails and auditable controls, making complex AWS adoption safer and more repeatable for analytics and ML workloads.

Implemented SOC 2-aligned AWS controls for regulated insurers adopting analytics and ML.
